context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 29 Stripe → Epoch/Paymentico migration fully tested. All Stripe code removed from backend. New payment providers (Epoch for fan checkout, Paymentico for creator SEPA payouts) are scaffolded with feature flags OFF by default. All new endpoints return 503 until merchant accounts are activated. Coin-based flows (tip, subscribe, unlock) continue to work. Frontend correctly reads /api/payments/config and gates card payment buttons. No Stripe mentions in UI.

notes.stripe_removal: Stripe SDK completely removed from backend imports. All Stripe-related endpoints either removed or return deprecated/disabled status.

notes.paymentico_status: PAYMENTICO_ENABLED=false by default. Paymentico client scaffolded but not active until merchant account approved.
notes.coin_flows: All coin-based flows (tip, subscribe, unlock, payout request) continue to work independently of payment provider status.
notes.frontend_gating: Frontend correctly reads /api/payments/config and disables card payment buttons when epoch.enabled=false.
